Commentary.Commentary: Excellent morning for Pakistan and they are on the cusp of a comfortable Test victory. West Indies needed a good first session to stay afloat in the game but Amir and Abbas sent down lively spells to nip those dreams in the bud. Yasir then cleaned up the tail to register a 6-fer while Wahab had a wicket to his name as well. None of the WI batsmen looked determined to fight it out. Just a matter of time now before the tourists take a 1-0 lead. The chase is set to begin shortly.

OUT! THAT WRAPS IT UP! Floated around off, Gabriel  goes for the big slog but gets a top edge that skies up in the air towards extra cover. Abbas from mid off runs across to his left and settles nicely under the skier. Sixth scalp for Yasir and it's befitting that he took the last wicket. PAKISTAN NEED JUST 32 TO WIN THE TEST.
Drifting in around off, blocked solidly from the crease.
Fuller outside off, leans into it and blocks solidly.
Shannon Gabriel is the last man in!
9th five-wicket haul in Tests for Yasir Shah!

OUT! FIFER FOR YASIR! His ninth in Tests and it's been a match-turning spell this. Lovely leg break drifting in from around middle, spins away to rap Joseph on the front pad as he looks to play across the line. That looked close and the umpire's finger goes up instantly. The leggie is overjoyed and is hugged by his teammates. Down to the last wicket now with the lead still on 31. Formalities being mopped up here by the visitors.
On a length outside off, stays back and blocks well.
Good length outside off, sits back and blocks it towards cover.
Almost another! Cracking delivery from Wahab and it tails away late after pitching. Joseph had no clue as he poked at it, only to get a nick that just sneaks through the slip cordon. Single taken.
Alzarri Joseph walks out to bat.

OUT! EDGED AND GONE! Wahab has one to his name. Keeps pegging away on the fourth stump line and gets this to tail away just a shade as Holder drives lazily at it. The outside edge barely carries to Sarfraz who takes a good low catch. Big blow to the hosts as their skipper is capable of batting out time. Just two wickets left now with the lead 30.
Length ball outside off, tails in a bit as Jason lets it pass.
Sprays down the leg side, Holder tries to glance it but fails to put bat on ball.
Drinks break....
Flatter around middle, stays back and punches it to cover.
Another leg break fizzing from the rough and Chase is struck on the pads as he offers no shot.
Loopy and outside leg, spins away sharply to rap Chase on the pads as he looks to block.
Floated around leg stump, presses forward and blocks solidly.
Ripper! Lovely leg break from outside leg, spins sharply past the outside edge and goes on the bounce to first slip. Vicious turn!
Floated around leg stump, leans across and tickles it towards short fine leg.
FOUR! Streaky! Holder continues to poke tentatively and this time get an edge that goes wide of the slip cordon to the third man fence for a boundary.
Good length around off, defends it solidly from the crease.
PEACH! Good length closer to off stump, tails away late with bounce as Holder is beaten neck and crop on the poke. Lovely delivery!
Back of a length outside off, Holder blocks it off the back foot to cover.
On a length outside off, pushed off the back foot towards cover.
Almost forces a nick! Angles in a length ball from outside off, holds its line after pitching as the ball whizzes past the outside edge.
Wahab Riaz comes on to bowl.
Quicker through  the air around off, punched off the back foot.
Flatter one around middle, tucked behind square on the leg side for a couple.
Floats it up around middle, Chase gets down to sweep but misses and is hit on the pads.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Tossed up delivery outside off, Chase pushes it with the turn towards the off side.
Comes down the track a bit and pushes it towards covers for one.
Length ball outside off, punched off the back foot towards the cover region again.
Good length ball, served outside off, Roston presses forward and defends it towards cover.
Fuller ball, angling in, blocked into the ground.
Angles it in from outside off, Chase isn't interested in playing that.
Good length delivery on off, Chase shoulders his arms.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Chase punches it over a leaping fielder at covers. The man from mid off gives it a chase and keeps them down to two.
Loopy leg break turning away, Holder tucks it again towards mid-wicket.
Drifting in on middle, wristed towards mid-wicket.
Tossed up around off, Holder stonewalls it.
A slider around middle, Holder negotiates it.
FOUR! Gorgeous hit! With the ball turning away how on earth did Holder create that angle. Gets a bit forward and thwacks it straight back down the ground for a boundary.
Bowls it on a length around off, Holder punches it towards the right of the bowler.
Abbas slips one on the pads, Chase wrists it towards short mid-wicket.
Length delivery, on the off stump, Chase defends it down gently.
Abbas hits the deck hard this time, Roston sits under it.
Back of a length delivery outside off, punched off the back foot towards covers.
FOUR! Good shot! Angles it full on middle, Roston Chase times his on drive to perfection to beat the man at mid on. It races to the fence for a boundary.
Length ball outside off, Chase offers a solid defense towards covers.
Googly around middle and off, Jason looks to defend but gets it off the inner half towards short leg.
Wrong 'un on middle, Holder counters it well off the back foot.
Floats it up outside off, Holder presses forward to defend but gets it off the outer part towards first slip.
Flatter one around off, Holder stays back in defense.
Keeps it full on middle, Holder bunts it towards mid on.
Quicker ball around middle, Holder strides forward in defense.
On middle and leg, tickled down to fine leg for a single.
FOUR! SHOT! Fullish ball outside off, Holder leans into it nicely and strokes the drive beautifully past cover. Splits the gap as the ball races to the fence for a boundary.
Good length on off, gets across and blocks solidly.
The skipper, Jason Holder walks in next!

OUT! ABBAS HAS ANOTHER! Pakistan are absolutely elated and the lower order has been exposed now. Lovely indipper from Abbas and it raps Dowrich on the front pad as he plays across the line. Looks dead plumb and the lbw appeal is given instantly. Shane decides to review it. Replays show that there is no bat involved and ball tracking shows it to be hitting middle and leg stump. Double strike from the debutant and the hosts are reeling now.
Dowrich has been given out lbw and he decides to review it. Unless there is an inside edge, he is a goner.
Fuller outside off, pushed gently towards cover.
Shane Dowrich is the new man in.

OUT! BISHOO DEPARTS! Really loose shot but he has overstayed his role of a nightwatchman though. Still, WI would have wanted him to dig in further. Sees the width on offer and slashes without any footwork. Gets a thick edge that flies to second slip where Younis Khan takes a comfortable catch. WI lead by just 8 runs with only four wickets left in the tank.
Fuller outside off, reaches out and blocks it solidly.
Loopy and outside off, pushed gently to cover.
Full and outside off, presses forward and blocks well.
Drifting in from around off, blocked solidly from the crease.
Full and outside off, leans into and defends it solidly.
Full and around off, driven firmly back to the bowler.
Fuller outside off, reaches out and blocks it solidly.
Short ball around middle, Bishoo ducks under the bumper.
Length ball sprayed wider outside off, easy leave for Bishoo.
Good length closer to off stump, left alone to the keeper.
Fuller outside off, Bishoo presses forward and defends solidly.
Length ball outside off, Bishoo pats it to cover.
Drifting in around middle, Chase goes across to flick but is hit on the pads.
Full and outside off, presses forward and defends well to mid off.
Full and outside off, presses forward and blocks well.
Drifting in around off, defends solidly from the crease.
Fuller outside off, jammed out towards cover.
FOUR! Bad ball and punished! A bit short and outside off, Chase cuts it away through point to find the fence. Good to see positive intent from the hosts. That's the only way they can save this game.
Drinks break...
Good length closer to off stump, Bishoo blocks firmly from the crease.
On middle and leg, Chase clips it through square leg. Picks the gap and they will get three more as it is tidied up near the ropes.
Back of a length outside off, pushed off the back foot to cover.
Length ball outside off, Chase stays in the crease and blocks it towards cover.
On a length closer to off stump, nips in sharply as Chase lets it pass.
Fuller around off, tails in a bit, driven firmly towards mid on.
Mohammad Abbas comes on to bowl.
FOUR! West Indies lead by 1 now! Short and outside off, enough room given to the batsman. Bishoo stays put and cuts it firmly past point to pick up second boundary of the over.
Floated around middle, bunted back to the bowler.
FOUR! Hits it against the turn! Loopy delivery, turning in from outside off, Bishoo gets down on one knee and smokes it over mid on for a boundary.
Full around middle, Bishoo jams it out.
Tossed up delivery around middle, pushed past the bowler for a single.
Short and outside off, Bishoo glides it through point for a single.
Fuller and angling in on middle, flicked towards mid-wicket.
Fuller and manages to nip it back as Chase has a tentative push at it. Much to his delight he gets an inside edge on the pads.
Fuller and angling away from over the wicket, Chase shoulders his arms with ease.
Back of a length outside off, Chase doesn't chase it.
Touch fuller on middle, Chase jams it out back to the bowler.
Fuller outside off, from around the wicket, Chase shoulders his arms.
Drops it short on middle, Bishoo goes back and pulls it to deep square leg for a couple.
Turning in from outside off, tucked towards FSL.
Googly served around off, it stays a tad low and Bishoo is beaten all ends up on the attempted poke.
Loopy leg break around off, Bishoo keeps it out.
Flatter outside off, tapped off the back foot towards point.
Tossed up outside off, turning in as Bishoo keeps it out.
Good length delivery on middle, defended off the back foot.
Roston Chase walks in next!

OUT! Off stump goes cartwheeling! Vishaul Singh had no clue whatsoever! Amir hurls it on a length outside off and it nips back in viciously after pitching. Poor Singh shoulders his arms and the ball takes the off stump apart. WI have lost half their side now and still trail by 11 runs.
FOUR! Easily done! Back of a length delivery outside off, Vishaul Singh stays back, opens the face of the bat and steers it behind point for a boundary.
Back of a length outside off, the debutant doesn't play at it.
Fuller outside off, a punchy drive towards mid off.
Good length delivery outside off, Singh shoulders his arms to it.
Another wrong 'un outside off, Bishoo looks to defend but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Floats it outside off, Singh comes forward to defend but the ball goes off the pads towards point and they take a leg bye.
Goes back to this flatter ball and keeps it out.
Googly outside off, Vishaul prods forward to defend but gets it high on the bat and dies down in front of silly point.
Outside off, turning in, turned to square leg off the back foot.
Tossed up outside off, Singh comes down the track and buries it into the ground.
Good length delivery on off, Bishoo looks to poke at it but gets beaten all ends up.
Fuller outside off, squeezed out to point.
On a length outside off, Bishoo pushes it towards point with soft hands.
Amir goes wide of the crease and serves it a bit full on off, Devendra pushes it towards covers.
Length ball outside off, defended with a straight bat.
Bangs in a short ball on middle, Bishoo ducks under it.
Floated around off, blocked solidly from the crease.
Fuller around off, leans across and pushes it towards mid on.
Fuller on middle and leg, leans across and clips it down the leg side.
Drifting in from outside off, Singh hangs back and blocks well.
Slightly short around off, blocked solidly off the back foot.
Fuller in length and Bishoo bunts it to mid on for a single.
Shortish outside off, pushed off the back foot to mid on for a single.
BEATEN! Lovely line and length from Amir around off stump, Bishoo is stuck on the crease as he hangs his bat at it. The ball fizzes past the edge.
Dug in short around off, Bishoo evades the bumper.
Fuller outside off, Bishoo drives it sweetly past mid off for a couple.
On a length outside off, blocked solidly off the back foot.
Down the leg side, Bishoo gets across to flick but misses.
Tossed up wider outside off, nice footwork from Singh, steps out and drives it through extra cover for a brace.
Flighted on a length on off stump, tucked towards mid-wicket. Confusion in the running but they eventually scrape through.
Drifting in from outside off, Bishoo covers the turn and blocks solidly off the back foot.
On a length around off, defended solidly off the back foot down the pitch.
Looped up on off, once again too full and that allows Bishoo to wrist it towards mid on.
Tossed up outside off, leans into it and pushes firmly towards mid off.
Fullish and outside off, pushed gently towards cover for a quick single.
On a length around off stump, Bishoo gets right behind the line and blocks solidly to cover.
Make that three in a row! Lovely start from Amir this. Honing in on that area close to the off stump and forces Bishoo to poke at it. Beats the edge once more.
Almost a replica of the previous ball. Bishoo tamely pokes at it but is lucky not to get a nick once more as the ball just holds its line after pitching.
Play and a miss! Angles in a length ball outside off, straightens after pitching as the ball whizzes past the outside edge. No footwork from Bishoo at all.
On a length outside off, Vishaul hangs back and taps it in the gap at cover for a single.
Mohammad Amir to bowl from the other end.
Tossed up outside off, Yasir isn't getting the length right and Singh steps out to take it on the full. Drives it towards cover-point for an easy single to keep strike.
Looped up wider outside off, Bishoo reaches out and pats it towards cover-point for a single.
Spinning in on a length from outside off, blocked solidly off the back foot to short leg.
Flighted nicely outside off, Bishoo presses forward to that one and smothers it.
Slightly short outside off, Vishaul camps back and punches it past cover for a single to get off the mark.
Tossed up very full around off, Singh looks to drive but gets it off the inside half down the track.

It's time to get underway. It's bright and sunny at the moment and Pakistan will be happy with this. West Indies batsmen - Vishaul Singh and Devendra Bishoo are out to bat. Pakistan begin with Yasir Shah straigthaway. A slip and a short leg in place...

Welcome back for the final day's play. A misfiring final session yesterday for the hosts means that they are in a fragile position at present. The surface is aiding spin and Yasir has already spun a web around the West Indies batsmen. All is not lost though for the home side. If a couple of batsmen can dig in, they could save the game but the task won't be easy. Crucial first session for them. Let's hope the weather and ground conditions are fine for the scheduled early start.
.....DAY 5, SESSION 1.....

Once Pakistan took a sizeable lead, it was clear that they couldn't lose the game and that the only team that could were the hosts. West Indies are staring the barrel now with Yasir's spell breathing life into the seemingly lifeless game. West Indies trail by just 28 runs though and they will hope for a partnership to eat into the deficit and build some sort of a lead so that they can take out time from the game. Won't be easy on a deteriorating pitch against an in-form Yasir. Join us tomorrow at 0930 local for the final day's play. Till then, it's goodbye from us.

Brilliant finish to the day for Pakistan. Yasir Shah was simply incredible in the final session, exploiting the dry surface and the cracks to perfection. Only Powell looked settled but he too was removed just before stumps to put the hosts in a hole. The leg spinner has all the four wickets to fall so far and is looking ominous with day five still to come. Earlier in the day, Misbah's unbeaten 99 was the talking point as he was left agonizingly stranded without a ton. However, his stand with Sarfraz gave Pakistan a more than handy lead.

Good ball! Very full and it tails away late as Devendra Bishoo has a tentative poke at it. The ball whizzes past the outside edge and goes on the bounce to Sarfraz Ahmed behind. The bails are off - IT'S STUMPS ON DAY 4! WI trail by 28!
Fuller and curling back in, the batsman pushes it forcibly towards covers.
Sprays it a bit wide outside off, Devendra goes after it away from the body and gets beaten.
Pitches it on a length around off, it holds its line as Bishoo leaves it alone.
FOUR LEG BYES! Sprays it down the leg side, Bishoo looks to flick but the ball goes off the pads and runs between the keeper and leg gully for a boundary towards fine leg.
Short of a length delivery on middle, it rises off the deck as Bishoo ducks to evade it. The ball goes off the helmet to Sarfraz who takes it and starts to appeal for an LBW. Funny scene!
Vishaul Singh is the new man in.

OUT! Yasir Shah with his 4th wicket! He's unstoppable at the moment. Keeps running in excitement! He's breached the West Indies today. Bowls a tossed up delivery outside off, a bit of extra bounce as a set Powell prods forward to defend. Gets an outside edge and veteran Younis Khan gobbles it with ease at first slip. WI still trail by 32 runs and are in deep trouble.
Goes deep in the crease and tucks it past short fine leg.
Googly around middle, Powell reads it to dig it out.
Stays back and defends it towards the off side.
FOUR! Drilled away! Floated delivery outside off, it's in the slot as Powell clears the front leg and drills it past a diving mid off fielder for a boundary.
Short and turning in, turned away towards short mid-wicket.
Angles it away outside off, Bishoo taps it towards gully.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Edged but doesn't carry! On a length and squares Bishoo up as he gets an outside edge which falls short of Younis Khan at third slip.
Good length on off, Bishoo looks to poke at it but is beaten all ends up.
Good length, straightens a touch after pitching, Powell looks to defend but gets an outside edge which rolls down to third man for a single.
On a length and outside off, Powell defends it towards the fielder at point.
On middle and leg, worked gently towards square leg.
Fuller and outside off, driven firmly to mid off.
Flatter outside off, a bit of turn again and Bishoo blocks solidly off the back foot.
The leg break spins in with bounce as Bishoo somehow fends it off the back foot.

The nightwatchman, Devendra Bishoo, walks out to bat. Coincidentally, a couple of balls ago, Sarfraz was yelling in Hindi to his teammates that they need to strike quickly and bring Bishoo (nightwatchman) in soon. Well, the visitors have got their wish.

OUT! YASIR HAS ANOTHER! That looked dead plumb in normal motion but Hope had other ideas and went for the review. He missed the slider on the front foot block and got rapped flush on the front pad. The umpire didn't take any time in raising his finger for the lbw appeal. On the DRS, the ball tracking showed no bat involved and crashing into middle stump. The on-field stays and it's a timely strike for Pakistan. WI still trail by 37.
Hope has been given out lbw. Looks quite plumb but he has decided to review it. Let's see.
Floated on a length on off, worked off the back foot to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Fullish and slanting in from around off, Hope gets across and jams it towards mid on.
Full and wider outside off, Hope leans forward nicely and threads the gap at cover with a firm push. Times it well and picks up a brace.
On a length outside off, Hope stays back and pats it towards cover-point.
Length ball angling in from around the wicket, wider outside off and Hope lets it pass.
On a length on off stump, pushed off the back foot towards short cover.
Length ball angling across the right-hander, left alone to the keeper.
On a length outside off, turning in, Powell stands tall and blocks with a straight bat.
Flatter leg break on off stump, worked with the turn to mid-wicket.
Full and wider outside off, presses forward and smothers it to the ground.
FOUR! TOP SHOT! Wow! Powell uses his feet beautifully to the flighted delivery and absolutely nails the drive through extra cover. Nobody budged an inch there, they didn't have the time to actually.
Silly point in place now.

Once again fuller outside off, Hope drives it sweetly to mid off where substitute Shadab puts in a dive but the ball sneaks through. It stops inside the ropes as he gives chase to tidy up. Three more to the total.
Tossed up very full on off stump, squeezed out towards mid off.
This one comes back in! Probing stuff from Amir as he gets one to jag back in from outside off, good leave in the end by Powell.
Almost an edge! The away swinger on fourth stump line, Powell is tempted into the poke and is beaten by the movement.
Fuller this time outside off, Hope creams it towards cover where the fielder gets a hand on it to slow the pace. Mid off moves across to his left to tidy up as the batsmen take a single.
Speared well outside off, Hope offers no shot to that one.
Full and around off, tailing in, worked in front of square on the leg side for a single.
Good length outside off, blocked off the back foot towards cover.
Mohammad Amir is back on.
It's the wrong 'un, but a bit too full. Hope drives it hard but finds the man at short extra cover who parries it towards mid off.
Yasir is htting the right length! Bowls it a lot quicker outside off, Hope lets it go.
Quicker one around middle, skidding through the surface and stays a bit low. Shai Hope does well to keep it out.
Shai Hope walks out to bat!

OUT! Gone next ball! Yasir Shah gets his man and punches the air in delight! Bowls a quicker short ball outside off on the rough, the ball turns in with sharp bounce as Shimron Hetmyer goes back to cut it. He's given no room and in fact he gets an inside edge which goes on the bounce to disturb the timber. That's unlucky but Pakistan will take it. WI trail by 49!
50-run stand between Hetmyer and Powell!

SIX! What a shot that is! Loopy leg break outside off, turning in a bit, Hetmyer comes down the track, gets low in his crease and spanks it with a lovely slog sweep over wide long on for a biggie all the way.
Loopy ball outside off, Hetmyer prods forward and defends it in front of silly point.
Silly point comes in place now!
FOUR! Easy pickings those! Sprays down the leg side and this time Kieran Powell doesn't miss out on a freebie! He moves inside the line and deflects it neatly off the pads to the fine leg fence.
Comes across a touch and defends it towards the man at short mid-wicket.
Strangles it down the leg side, Kieran misses his flick and Sarfraz behind the stumps dives to his right to collect it. Wayward!
Angling in on middle, defended down on the pitch.
Outside off, KP ignores.
FOUR! PO-thats-Well-hit! Shortish outside off, Kieran stays back, keeps his bat face open, uses all the pace and guides it past point to fetch himself another boundary.
Goes back and turns it towards square leg.
Quicker one on the pads, worked through square leg for a single.
Stays put and stonewalls it.
Full around off, defended into the ground.
Kicks off the deck from a good length and hits Powell on the top half of the bat before dying down. The pitch is starting to spice up now.
Flatter outside off, Powell taps it towards the off side.

A loud shout for LBW! A length ball, angling in on middle, Hetmyer looks to work it across the line but misses and is hit on the pads. An appeal for LBW is turned down by umpire Kettleborough. Oh dear, replays show it would have been hitting the leg stump.
FOUR! Top edge! Short ball, kicking off the deck as Hetmyer opts for the pull. Gets a big top edge over the keeper to the fine leg fence for a boundary.
Sliding on leg, glanced fine down the leg side for a single.
Bangs in a short ball on middle, Powell ducks under it.
Back of a length delivery outside off, steered towards gully.
FOUR! FLAYED! Short and a wide outside off, allows Powell to free his arms and lashes this through the left of the point fielder to find the fence. Nice positive batting this from these two.
Flighted outside off, leans into it and smothers the ball on to the track.
On a length outside off, turning in, punched off the back foot towards cover.
FOUR! Nice shot! Spots the length early and nails the fuller ball with a sweep through backward square leg for a boundary.
Floated outside off, defends it solidly off the front foot.
Full and outside off, presses forward and blocks solidly.
The leg break spins in sharply from middle, worked with the turn towards short fine leg.
Good length ball, angling in, Powell offers a solid front foot defense.
Slower full toss, dipping in as the batsman bunts it towards mid on.
Back of a length outside off, Kieran steers it straight to gully this time.
FOUR! Beautifully done! On a length and moves away outside off, Powell gets back and plays with an angled bat past a diving gully fielder for a boundary.
Touch fuller on off, punched towards mid on.
Good length delivery on off, Powell looks to defend it with a straight bat but gets a thick inside edge on the boot.
Drinks called!
Short and turning in sharply around the rough, Hetmyer goes back and somehow manages to defend.
Tossed up around off, it's very full as Hetmyer drives it back to the bowler.
Stays back and works it with the spin through square leg for a single.
Full outside off, defended off the front foot.
Loopy delivery around off, turning in as Powell looks to flick. He misses and is hit on the pads as the ball lobs up towards covers.
Shimron comes down the track and jams it out towards mid on for a single.
The batsman defends it from within the crease. They pick up a single.
Short on middle, tickled down to fine leg for one.
Slower delivery on the pads, ends up as a low full toss, flicked to deep square leg for a single.
Slightly full around off, Hetmyer drives it towards mid off.
Back of a length delivery on middle, Shimron hangs back to defend.
On a length outside off, Hetmyer pushes it away towards point.
Wahab Riaz is back into the attack!
Hetmyer comes down the track and drives it towards mid off for a quick single.
Pitches it on the rough outside off, turns back in as Hetmyer works it off the back foot towards FSL.
Full around off, eased down to long off for a single.
Tossed up around off, Kieran goes back and tucks it once again in the same region.
Around middle and leg, defended towards mid-wicket.
FOUR! Nicely done! Loopy ball outside off, Powell sinks down on one knee, takes it on the full and paddles it sweetly down to fine leg for a boundary.

Where is the ball? Abbas gets this one to nip in from around off, Hetmyer brings his bat down at the angle but gets an inside edge on the pads and searches where the ball is. The ball dies down near the stumps.
Shortish delivery on the hips, Powell tucks it towards fine leg for a single.

FOUR! Delicious! Abbas overpitches it outside off, Powell leans into it and drives it ever so crisply through extra cover for a boundary. That had four written all over it.
Good length delivery on off, Kieran punches it towards the man at short cover.

Edged but falls well short! Bowls it on the rough outside off, Hetmyer looks to defend but gets an outside edge which dips well in front of Younis Khan at first slip. Oh hello, but why is veteran standing so deep? He should come close.
Loopy delivery outside off, turning in as Hetmyer clips it past short leg for a couple of runs to get off the mark.

The ball goes onto rattle the furniture and that spells the end for Kraigg who walks back dejected. WI trail by 99 runs!

On a length outside off, shaping away a bit, Kraigg taps it gently to cover.
Fuller outside off, leans into it and pushes it to cover.
Good length around off, gets on the back foot and blocks it solidly to cover.
Fullish around middle, tailing in a bit as Powell jams it to mid on.

Good length just outside off, nicely left alone to the keeper.

Back of a length outside off, stays back and blocks it well.
Fuller but sprayed down the leg side, Kraigg misses the flick.
Length ball just outside off, Kraigg lets it pass to the keeper.
Good length outside off, KB shoulders arms to that one.
Good length angled in closer to off stump, shaping away a bit as Powell lets it pass.
Length ball around middle, worked away through mid-wicket for a brace.
On a length outside off, left alone to the keeper.
Fuller and outside off, leans into it and drives towards mid off.
Good length outside off, left alone to the keeper.
Full and around middle, Powell tucks it with the angle towards mid-wicket.
Full and outside off, presses forward and blocks it solidly.
BEATEN AGAIN! Abbas is getting prodigious away movement off the cracks. Brathwaite tries to push at it with no footwork and is once again lucky not to get a nick. Lovely bowling!
On a length around off, blocked solidly from the crease.
Good length around off, defends it solidly from the crease.
BEATEN! On a length outside off, shapes away late as Brathwaite is beaten on the poke. That was very close to the outside edge.
Shortish outside off, stays back and flays it through point for a brace.
Full and outside off, no stroke offered again to that one.
Fullish and slanting in from just outside off, left alone to the keeper.
On a length outside off, stays back and taps it to point.
Short ball and Powell ducks under the bumper.
Full and just outside off, no stroke offered to that one.
Length ball wider outside off, left alone to the keeper.
On a length outside off, seaming away a bit as Brathwaite taps it towards cover-point.
Good length closer to off stump, watchfully left alone by Kraigg.
Slightly short and wide outside off, Brathwaite cuts it towards backward point where Shehzad makes a good stop. Saves a certain boundary.
Good length on off stump, gets across and clips it towards mid-wicket.
Back of a length outside off, stays back and punches it past cover for a single.
Good length around off, nips in a touch as Powell gets a faint inside edge on to the front pad. Lobs up for a while but dies down instantly as Abbas tries to reach it in vain in his followthrough.

THAT WAS CLOSE! Amir gets one back to straighten a bit after angling it in from around off. Powell looks to work across the line but gets a leading edge that just flies past the point fielder to the deep. Single taken.
Full and outside off, pushed firmly to mid off.
On a length outside off, punched off the back foot to the off side.
Fuller and around off, pushed gently towards mid on.
Short ball and Powell ducks under quickly.

JUST SHORT! Back of a length angling across Brathwaite who pokes tentatively at it. The ball shapes away a bit to force the outside edge but it doesn't carry to Younis at second slip and sneaks through the cordon. Single taken.
Sprayed down the leg side, Powell tries to flick but misses.
FOUR! Clipped away! Too full and on the pads, Powell feasts on it with a nice flick through mid-wicket. Times it well to get a boundary.

DROPPED! Caught and bowled chances aren't easy but these are usually taken at this level. Fuller ball and Powell drives it straight back at Abbas who shells it in his followthrough. Wasn't that tough a chance actually. The debutant will be disappointed.
On a length outside off, Powell defends it firmly off the back foot.
On middle and leg, Brathwaite clips it down to fine leg for a single.
FOUR! Starts with an overpitched ball outside off, Brathwaite takes full toll of it with a drill past mid off. Strong bottom hand shot and it races away to the fence.
Mohammad Abbas to share the new cherry.
Fullish and just outside off, nicely driven to mid off.
Good length closer to off stump, Powell defends well from the crease.
On a length outside off, left alone to the keeper.
On a good length outside off, a bit of shape away as Powell lets it pass.
Good length in the fourth stump line, nice leave by Powell.
Length ball around middle, pushed off the back foot to the right of Wahab who misfields at mid-wicket to give a run. WI are off and running.
